notes: أَبِی ره opens the chain as the compiler's father, named only by relation
هشام أو بعض أصحابنا are alternatives in one level (rule 2); بعض أصحابنا is an unnamed collective
عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ is a gap, unnamed (rule 8)
the Imam is written after عن, so he is a narrator (owner ruling 2); the saying is his words
